title: Getting started with cangeocode
text: Hand reverse_geocode() longitude/latitude pair returns every address within match radius, nearest first. dist metres. conversion needed: addresses stored projected CRS (Statistics Canada Lambert, EPSG:3347), distances come metric already. default radius 100 m.
